query: Please implement an online learning platform for creating and managing courses, booking time slots, and conducting video sessions. The platform should have functionalities for course creation and management, time slot booking management, online video sessions, gamification features, user profile creation, and service (course or private class) web pages. Users should be able to log in, create and manage their own courses, book time slots, attend online video sessions, view their user profiles, and browse service web pages. Assign linen to the background and saddle brown to the UI elements.
